member.name: LineStatusMarginBase.Class
member.summary: Provides the shared text-view wiring for margins that paint a marker beside every visible marked line.

member.name: LineStatusMarginBase.Remarks
member.para: The margin invalidates itself when its text view, visual lines, or scroll offset change.

A subclass whose source notifies changes registers the source through ; the margin then invalidates itself when the source raises while it is connected to a text view, subscribing and unsubscribing with the connection. Registering the source after the margin is already connected subscribes right away.
Subclasses supply the marked line numbers through and paint their marker through .
The reserved width is owned by this class through and scales with ; concrete margins that need a different authored default override the property's default value.

member.name: RejectNullValue
member.summary: Rejects for a property whose type the framework already enforces, so a validation callback only has to keep the render pass safe from XAML and SetValue nulls.

member.name: QueueVisualInvalidation
member.summary: Queues a visual invalidation on the margin's dispatcher while it remains connected to its current text view.

member.name: QueueVisualInvalidation.Remarks
member.para: The invalidation runs at . Multiple notifications that arrive while an invalidation is queued coalesce into one; the queue gate is released when the queued action runs, so a later notification queues again.

member.name: GetFontScale
member.summary: Gets the scale factor applied to the margin's marker and reserved width, derived from the margin's inherited font size relative to .
member.remarks: The framework's font-size validation rejects non-positive and non-finite values, so the 1.0 fallback is defensive: the guarded configuration is not reachable through the font-size property.
member.returns: The font-size scale factor, or 1.0 when the margin's font size is not a positive finite number.

member.name: DesignFontSize
member.summary: The font size, in device-independent pixels, for which a concrete margin's default marker geometry and reserved width are authored.
member.remarks: Margins scale their marker and reserved width by the ratio of their own font size to this value, so the margin width stays proportional to the text when the editor font changes.

member.name: IsSourceSubscribed
member.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the margin is subscribed to the source's changed event while it has a text view.

member.name: IsInvalidationQueued
member.summary: Gets a value indicating whether a coalesced visual invalidation is currently queued.

member.name: SetNotifyingSource
member.summary: Assigns the notifying source that follows the margin's text-view connection and invalidates the margin when its marked lines may have changed.
member.remarks: Call this once from the constructor of a margin whose source notifies changes. The margin subscribes while it is connected to a text view and unsubscribes when it is detached; a notification that arrives while connected is coalesced into one queued invalidation. Calling this method a second time is rejected because the live subscription cannot be transferred to another source. A subclass that needs a different reaction to source notifications can subscribe to the source's event itself instead of registering it here.
member.exception: A notifying source is already assigned.

member.name: FollowSourceNotifications
member.summary: Follows when it implements , so a margin constructor wires a notifying source without repeating the type test.

member.name: MarginWidth
member.summary: Gets or sets the width reserved for line-status markers, authored at the design font size.
member.remarks: Changing the value invalidates the margin's measure. The effective width scales with the margin's font size (see ).
member.exception: The assigned value is negative, , or infinite, so the property's validation callback rejects it and the setter throws.

member.name: GetEffectiveMarginWidth
member.summary: Gets the width available to the marker: the margin's arranged width when it has one, otherwise the scaled reserved width, which is the value used before the first arrange pass.
member.returns: The width available to the marker, in device-independent pixels.

member.name: GetMarkedLineNumbers
member.summary: Gets the one-based document line numbers that currently have a marker, in ascending order. Line numbers outside the document are ignored by the render pass.
member.remarks: The margin queries this member during every render pass while it is visible, so an implementation should serve a cached result instead of recomputing the marked lines per pass.

member.name: DrawMarker
member.summary: Draws the marker for one marked visual line.
member.param: The drawing context of the margin.
The visual line to draw the marker for.
The y-position of the top of 's line box, in margin coordinates. The line box spans from this position; the marker should stay inside those bounds.
